local P=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local out='none' for _,l in ipairs(P:GetDescendants()) do if l:IsA('TextLabel') and string.sub(l.Text,1,12)=='카드 수집' then local f=l:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('ScrollingFrame') if f then f.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,l.AbsolutePosition.Y-f.AbsolutePosition.Y+f.CanvasPosition.Y-6)) out='scrolled '..l.Text end break end end return 'GALLERY '..out

local L=game:GetService('LogService'):GetLogHistory() local e={} for _,m in ipairs(L) do if m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageError then table.insert(e,string.sub(m.message,1,160)) end end local msg='' for i=math.max(1,#e-5),#e do msg=msg..' ; '..e[i] end return 'ERRORS '..#e..msg
